why_this_exists: The Tranche 3C brief forbade building a pool-generation tool and forbade starting Tranche 4, but required the REPRODUCIBLE METHOD to be preserved so the next tranche does not reconstruct a pool from prose. This file is that method. It is deliberately NOT a tool: a tool would have to be written, reviewed and mutation-proved, which is the work the brief excluded.
not_a_tool_note: Do not treat this as a specification to implement blindly. When it IS implemented, the first thing to prove is that the derived pool is non-vacuous - that removing an exclusion rule changes the pool. A selection rule that excludes nothing has expired, and guard expiry is a confirmed defect class in this repository.

step_1_universe.what: Every candidate-facing q-card in the 86 question-bearing files.
step_1_universe.how: The canonical extractor, never a count of '.q-card' divs - that gives 723 against a canonical 721 and would give a wrong number here too. Use tools/oral/build_qb_content_index.py, or validate_batch_b.card_digests() for the balanced-tag spans.
step_1_universe.identity_key: file + anchor, e.g. 'QB6.html#q1'. NEVER the anchor alone: anchors are renumbered, and an anchor-only key invents new cards out of renumbered old ones - the exact defect that made the August monthly sheet claim 109 new cards against 50 governed ones.

step_2_risk_ranking.what: Rank the universe by change recency and by governed-record density.
step_2_risk_ranking.how: Glob tools/oral/*_manifest.json - BOTH batch_*_manifest.json and correction_*_manifest.json - and read every cards[] entry's file+anchor. A card touched recently, or touched by several records, is where a review finds most.
step_2_risk_ranking.trap: A manifest glob is a pointer, not evidence. An index row tells you WHERE TO LOOK and is not what you cite. Open the card.

step_3_hard_exclusions.rule: PRIOR EXPLICIT ACCEPT. A card a previous tranche examined and explicitly ACCEPTED is excluded from the pool.
step_3_hard_exclusions.why: Re-reviewing an accepted card spends the tranche's budget re-deriving a decision already made, and produces the appearance of new coverage.
step_3_hard_exclusions.requirement: The exclusion must name the tranche and the accept record. An exclusion with no citation is not an exclusion, it is an omission.

step_4_soft_exclusions.rule: CORRECTION-FAMILY SOFT EXCLUSION. A card corrected by a family in the immediately preceding tranche is de-prioritised, not removed.
step_4_soft_exclusions.why: Soft, because a correction is evidence the card was WORTH looking at. The three grain cards were corrected in three successive tranches and each pass found something the last did not.
step_4_soft_exclusions.requirement: Record which cards were soft-excluded and why, so the next tranche can see what was set aside rather than what was never considered.

step_5_reopen_rule.rule: A NARROWLY-CORRECTED card is reopened ONLY for a NEW EXPLICIT RISK REASON, stated before the card is read.
step_5_reopen_rule.why: Otherwise every tranche re-reads the last tranche's output and the pool never advances. Stating the reason first is what stops the reason being invented to justify what was found.
examples_of_a_valid_reason: A source the card depends on has moved (a revalidation trigger fired).
A sibling card in the same file was found defective on the same proposition.
The card carries a class of claim a NEW standing rule now governs - e.g. Tranche 3C's vessel-specific 'On My Vessel' provenance rule, or its recent-named-casualty ruling.

step_6_report_the_residue.rule: The unselected remainder is stated with its size and its selection reason, every time.
step_6_report_the_residue.why: A review that reports only what it looked at cannot be checked. Reporting 'N unselected, by rule X' is what makes the next tranche's starting pool derivable rather than remembered.

carried_forward_to_tranche_4.starting_pool: The ~16 cards Tranche 3 identified and did not select. Tranche 3C did NOT re-derive this list, because the brief forbade starting Tranche 4 and a list re-derived from a different method would not be the same list.

named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.what: The GFI card teaches the universal 'gCO2/DWT.nm' CII unit at 4 sites, including in a GFI-versus-CII contrast table where the unit IS the row. QB6.html therefore now teaches two versions of one unit, because F-2 was authorised card-scoped.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.why_not_fixed: Out of the authorised scope of F-2, which named QB6#q1.

named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.what: 5 sites of the same universal DWT unit. This is QB6's PAIRED REVISION LAYER - a candidate revising from the cheat sheet gets the uncorrected form. It is hand-maintained, so it does not regenerate.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.why_not_fixed: A separate file and a separate card surface; not named by F-2.

named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.what: Teaches 'UR Z7: ESP for Bulk Carriers and Tankers' and 'IACS UR Z7 for the Enhanced Survey Programme' at 4 sites. The held UR Z7 is 'Hull Classification Surveys'; Z7.1 is dry cargo ship hull surveys and Z7.2 is liquefied gas carrier hull surveys; ESP for bulk carriers and oil tankers is the Z10 series. This is the SAME defect CORR-URZ7-20260901 fixed in QB1_supplementary, surviving because that correction's sweep was FILTERED to hits mentioning machinery, CMS, CSM or continuous - and QB4_E's hits mention none of those.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.why_not_fixed: The brief scoped Z7 verification to propositions relied on by Z7-CORRECTED cards, and forbade a general IACS audit.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.reusable_lesson: A FILTERED SWEEP IS NOT A SWEEP. The filter that made the first correction tractable is the same filter that hid its sibling.

named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.what: Incidental occurrences of the universal DWT CII unit.
IACS UR Z27 (Condition Monitoring / Condition Based Maintenance) is cited candidate-facing but was NOT acquired. The brief bounded acquisition to Z7, Z18 and Z20.
The stem still reads 'sank off Paradip on 21/22 August 2026' while the corrected body resolves the sinking to 21 August. The stem is a hedge, not an error.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.why_not_fixed: Changing a stem moves the content-index display text and the workbook projection, which the brief's 'no Excel regeneration unless question identity or text changes require it' discourages. Recorded as a DECISION.

named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.what: The recent-named-casualty governance ruling was applied ONLY to Ocean Winner, on instruction. Other cards publish named casualties (MOL Comfort, Ever Given and others) with factual claims and no registered supporting source.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.why_not_fixed: The brief expressly forbade a corpus-wide casualty audit.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.the_question: Does the ruling extend to older, non-recent casualties, or is 'recent' load-bearing? The answer decides whether this is a 3-card job or a corpus sweep.

named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.what: 'UR Z7 for dry cargo ships' - strictly UR Z7.1. Defensible as a family reference.
named_findings_this_pass_reported_and_di.why_not_fixed: Not a mismatch worth a correction on its own.
